description.short_caption: Clustered vesicular lesions on the face, predominantly around the periocular region.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows numerous small, grouped vesicular lesions on an erythematous base distributed across the periocular region, including the upper eyelid, lower eyelid, and adjacent areas of the cheek and forehead. The lesions are uniform in size and appear to be fluid-filled. The surrounding skin shows mild erythema. The eye is closed, and there is no visible discharge or crusting in this image.
